43a0d77 is a merge commit; the actual introducing commit is 8b21759, confirmed as immediate predecessor.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 8b217592ce18bd392a54064140001b6ceef89bd4

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I used `git log -p --follow` on `java/src/libbun/parser/ast/ZNode.java` to trace the history of the constructor line that the fix commit touches. This revealed that the exact inverse change (`this.ParentNode = ParentNode;` → `ParentNode.SetChild(this, ZNode._EnforcedParent);`) was made just one commit earlier, in commit `8b217592ce18bd392a54064140001b6ceef89bd4` (same author, same day, 32 minutes before the fix). Commit `43a0d77` in between is a merge commit that brings `8b21759` into the mainline, so `8b21759` is the direct parent introducing the change into the history that `52fa0d5` later fixes.

**(2) Specific change:** In `8b21759`, the `ZNode` constructor was changed from a plain field assignment (`this.ParentNode = ParentNode;`) to a method call on the `ParentNode` argument (`ParentNode.SetChild(this, ZNode._EnforcedParent);`). Looking at `SetChild`'s definition (`public final ZNode SetChild(ZNode Node, boolean EnforcedParent) { ...; Node.ParentNode = this; ... }`), this is invoked as a method *on* `ParentNode`, meaning if `ParentNode` is `null` (which is a valid, expected case for root nodes — the original code handled it fine by simply assigning `null`), the call throws a `NullPointerException`. The fix commit `52fa0d5` reverts exactly this line back to the safe direct assignment.

**(3) Evidence:** The diff in `8b21759` is the byte-for-byte inverse of the diff in the bug-fixing commit `52fa0d5`, on the same file and same line, authored by the same person one commit earlier in the reachable history. This is strong, direct evidence — not just correlation — that `8b21759` introduced the regression that `52fa0d5` fixes.

I have high confidence in this identification given the exact inverse-diff match and short causal chain between the two commits.
